snippet.title: Dadi Kingdom | The Pact (Lore Teaser) | Early Access December 7, 2026
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4166450/Dadi_Kingdom/?utm_source=youtube
Wishlist on Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/dadi-kingdom-68230a
Free demo on both stores. Early Access starts December 7, 2026.

Long ago, three powers forged a pact: the Crown, the Church and the Mages. The pact has endured for generations. But a pact is only as strong as the one who holds it. And today, you sit upon the throne.

This is the story behind Dadi Kingdom, told in ten paintings, followed by a look at the gameplay.

Available in 13 languages.

Website: https://dadi-kingdom.de/en/
Discord: https://discord.gg/WbV4JbSEvq

#DadiKingdom #ActionRPG #Medieval #IndieGame #Lore
